gate: Underneath the surface of a day, something is burning. Not a thought, not yet a decision, just a low fire that wants to feel everything it can reach. This code is the drive to feel, full stop. The pull toward an experience because the experience matters to be had, not because anyone has approved it or because it leads anywhere useful. A person carrying this gate runs hot. Wanting is the weather here. The misread is to mistake the heat for who someone is, or to read the wanting as proof that action must follow now. The fire is information, not instruction. It says a thing is alive for you. It does not say to lunge. Left untended, this code clings, attaches the whole self to whatever object the desire has landed on, and turns into the suffering of trying to grip what was only ever meant to be felt and then released.
centre_field: The body-map carries this code in the emotional solar plexus, the only place that is both a motor and a way of knowing. That doubling is the teaching. Feelings here are not noise on the surface of thought. They are how the body is reading the room, generating heat, and making meaning, all at once. Decisions arrive through time in this centre, never on the spot. The wave has to move. There is a peak, there is a trough, there is the flat clearing afterwards, and only in the clearing is the read trustworthy. The misread is to take any single point of the wave as the truth and to act from it. The lower part of the wave is not failure. It is the centre completing its read. Welcome the low and the high both, or the centre becomes a thing to hide from instead of a sense organ to live in.
channel: On its own, this code is fuel without a spark. The wanting is enormous, the heat is there, but there is no starting line, no first move, no recognition that says begin. The reach is across the body toward the gate of contraction, the small pulse at the root that initiates, that says now, that opens the question. Together they form the channel of recognition, the collective wave that hopes hard, anticipates, and crashes when the picture does not match the imagined one. Alone, the feeling has nowhere to go and turns inward as longing. Joined, the longing finds its first step and the imagination finds its emotional weight. This is why the wave here is collective in shape, high highs and low lows: the desire is hitched to a picture, and pictures break. The completion of the circuit is not relief from the wave. It is the wave doing its work.
